index.title: Free Email Optimisation Tools
index.description: Thirteen free email marketing tools: check your copy before you send, read your A/B tests after, and test your domain's DMARC. No sign-up needed.

hypothesis.title: A/B Test Hypothesis Builder
hypothesis.description: Build an A/B test hypothesis you can prove wrong. Answer five questions, then plan the test's length with the Duration Calculator. Free, no sign-up.

ab-duration.title: A/B Test Duration Calculator
ab-duration.description: A free A/B test duration calculator for email: the sample size each variant needs, and how many days that takes at your volume. Plan it before you start.

sscc.title: Statistical Significance Calculator
sscc.description: A free A/B test significance calculator for email. Enter the sample size and each variant's rate to see if the result is significant or could be chance.

wewe.title: We-We Calculator
wewe.description: Paste your email and see how much of it talks about your brand and how much about your reader. A free pronoun count for customer-focused copy. No sign-up.

ers.title: Email Readability Score
ers.description: A free email readability checker: Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, and SMOG scores for your copy, with UK reading ages and suggestions. No sign-up.

f2b.title: Feature-to-Benefit Converter
f2b.description: Features vs benefits, sorted: enter a product feature, pick your industry, and get a benefit statement your reader cares about. Free, no sign-up.

tone.title: Email Tone Analyser
tone.description: Paste your copy into this free email tone checker to see which tones it gives off, from friendly to urgent, with phrases to strengthen each. No sign-up.

persona.title: Buyer Persona Matcher
persona.description: Paste your email to see which of four buyer types it reaches (Competitive, Spontaneous, Humanistic, and Methodical) and which it misses. Free, no sign-up.

emotional-appeal.title: Emotional Appeal Analyser
emotional-appeal.description: See which emotional appeals your email copy uses, from fear and hope to trust and belonging, and learn when each one works best. Free, no sign-up.

personalisation.title: Personalisation & Dynamic Content Checker
personalisation.description: A free email personalisation checker: find every token in your email and whether it has a fallback value, in the syntax of 16 email platforms. No sign-up.

accessibility.title: Email Accessibility Checker
accessibility.description: A free email accessibility checker: missing alt text, vague link text, small fonts, poor colour contrast, and broken heading order. No sign-up.

curve.title: CURVE Subject Line Builder
curve.description: A free subject line tester built on CURVE: Curiosity, Urgency, Relevance, Value, and Emotion. See which it covers and how to add the first one missing.

dmarc-checker.title: Free DMARC, SPF & DKIM Checker
dmarc-checker.description: A free DMARC checker for your domain's DMARC, SPF, and DKIM setup, in plain English: what's in place, what's missing, and what to fix. No sign-up.
